title: A Noetherian base for every N-invertible scheme
statement: For every natural number $N$, there is a scheme $U$ [def-pc-scheme] which is Noetherian, on which $N$ is invertible, and such that every scheme $S$ on which $N$ is invertible admits a morphism $S\to U$. No positivity or nonemptiness assumption is required.

source.place: Levelwise finite diagonal check, expanded in lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals

proof.text: Take $U=\operatorname{Spec}((\operatorname{ULift}\mathbf Z)[1/N])$. Transport Noetherianity of the integers through ULift and localize. The localization universal property and the global-sections/spectrum adjunction give a map from every N-invertible scheme to U. The localization map and the spectrum/global-sections comparison show N invertible on U. These are Mathlib constructions, and the displayed Lean proof directly assembles them.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteP1_exists_noetherianBase (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsNoetherian U),
      IsUnit (N : Γ(U, ⊤)) ∧
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}), IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)) → Nonempty (S ⟶ U)
